scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:services && npm run install:client
scripts.install:services: for d in services/*; do (cd "$d" && npm install); done
scripts.dev:services: concurrently "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:tenant" "npm run dev:user"
scripts.build: npm run build:services && npm run build:client
scripts.build:services: for d in services/*; do (cd "$d" && npm run build); done
scripts.test: npm run test:services && npm run test:client
scripts.test:services: for d in services/*; do (cd "$d" && npm test); done
